prayer: PRAYER: Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, to issue a writ of certiorarified mandamus calling for the records relating the impugned order passed by the 2nd respondent by his proceedings No. Na.Ka. No. R 4-16622-2024 dated 16-9-2025 and to quash the same and consequently directing the respondents to transfer the petitioner from 1st respondent to 2nd respondent Department and post as Warden in Government Polytechnic College, Konam, Nagercoil, in pursuant to the No Objection Certificate given by the 1st respondent.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Mummineni Sudheer Kumar, J.:— The learned counsel for the petitioner has given a letter, dated 16-3-2026, to the Registry, for listing this writ petition under the caption “For Withdrawal”.

2. Accordingly, this writ petition is listed today under the caption “For Withdrawal” and today, learned counsel for the petitioner has also made an endorsement in the court bundle seeking permission of this Court to withdraw this writ petition.

3. Recording the same, this writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn. No costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
